{{- /* Extract the same heading-anchored sections used by the search dialog. Keep .Plain as the searchable content; these sections supply result links/snippets. Splitting at headings preserves each heading and its following text up to the next heading. */ -}} {{- $sections := slice -}} {{- $separator := printf "%c" 30 -}} {{- $chunks := split (replaceRE `(?i)]*>` (printf "%s${0}" $separator) (string .)) $separator -}} {{- range after 1 $chunks -}} {{- $chunk := . -}} {{- $headings := findRE `(?is)^]*>.*?` . 1 -}} {{- with $headings -}} {{- $heading := index . 0 -}} {{- $opening := index (findRE `(?i)^]*>` $heading 1) 0 -}} {{- $ids := findRESubmatch `(?i)\bid="([^"]+)"` $opening -}} {{- with $ids -}} {{- $id := htmlUnescape (index (index . 0) 1) -}} {{- $title := strings.TrimSpace (htmlUnescape (plainify $heading)) -}} {{- $text := htmlUnescape (replaceRE `(?s)<[^>]+>` " " $chunk) | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace -}} {{- $sections = append (dict "id" $id "title" $title "text" $text) $sections -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $sections -}}
